instruction: In VS Code User settings, turn on word wrap for the editor.

command: cd /home/user/Downloads && unzip -q vscodeEvalExtension.zip && code --install-extension vscodeEvalExtension/eval-0.0.1.vsix && rm -rf vscodeEvalExtension vscodeEvalExtension.zip

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json via the vscode_config type, which is the exact User settings file the instruction refers to.
The 'Preferences: Open Settings (JSON)' command ensures the settings are accessible before the file is read from disk.

Metric check_json_settings correctly handles the type='rule' pattern: expected parameter receives the rules dict {"expected": {"editor.wordWrap": "on"}} and accesses expected['expected'] directly — no parameter mishandling.
Expected value 'editor.wordWrap': 'on' is semantically correct for enabling word wrap in VS Code.
Full coverage: the single requirement (turn on word wrap in User settings) is fully checked by the evaluator.
Negative control is sound: default User settings do not include editor.wordWrap, so the baseline correctly does not pass.
Postconfig activates the VS Code window before the getter runs, ensuring UI state is ready.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: the check_json_settings function signature types 'expected' as str but receives a Dict at runtime. Consider updating the type annotation to Dict for clarity, though this does not affect runtime behavior.

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent navigated VS Code with the Settings tab visible (step 0). The main task (open project folder) failed at step 6 due to UI confusion. Settings interaction capability was demonstrated at the start.
metadata.capability_extraction: Agent can navigate VS Code Settings UI and search for settings (shown in screenshot 0 with active Settings tab and search bar in use). Can enter text in search bars and interact with settings UI.
metadata.failure_analysis: Deviation at step 6 during folder-open dialog navigation. Settings-page tasks avoid the problematic folder dialog entirely and target the demonstrated capability.
metadata.task_rationale: Targets 'enter text or formulas' and 'select UI elements' demonstrated capabilities. Word wrap is a common editor setting that can be toggled via the Settings UI search. Uses built-in check_json_settings evaluator.
metadata.explanation: Task asks to enable word wrap in VS Code User settings (editor.wordWrap = 'on'). Getter reads ~/.config/Code/User/settings.json via vscode_config. Metric verifies the key is present with value 'on'. Default VS Code User settings have editor.wordWrap as 'off' (not set), so baseline does not pass.
